rows.en: See? You can't see at all!
Are you okay, Pinon-chan?

*cough* *cough*... I-I'm fine...
Sorry for the trouble...

Don't worry about it, Pinon-chan.
As long as you're safe, that's all that matters.

So what about today's training?
Think you can do it?

Yeah, I can!
I'll learn to swim before today is over!
All right! That's the spirit, Pinon-chan!
Uuu...

Pinon-chan,
nobody learns to swim in just one day.
R-really?

Really. With anything, it's the steady effort
that counts.

You're right... Yeah!
I couldn't learn to swim today, but next time!
Next time for sure...!
Let's keep it up, Pinon-chan.

Thanks for helping me train today...
Th-thank you...
W-well, see you!

(Pinon-chan's a hard worker, but she really
has zero athletic ability...)

(I'll have to keep helping Pinon-chan train
until she can swim.)

(Pinon-chan asked me to help her with something
again, but what could it be?)

Hey, Pinon-chan.
I just got here myself.
(No, actually, it's just what I expected...)
See? You can't see at all!

Don't worry about it, Pinon-chan.
As long as you're safe, that's all that matters.

Yeah, I can!
I'll learn to swim before today is over!
rows.notes: Source is one line; broken in two to fit.

rows.en: All right! That's the spirit, Pinon-chan!

Pinon-chan,
nobody learns to swim in just one day.

Really. With anything, it's the steady effort
that counts.
Let's keep it up, Pinon-chan.

(I'll have to keep helping Pinon-chan train
until she can swim.)

(Today I'm helping Pinon-chan with her
swimming training, but...)
Uuu... I'm not getting any better at swimming...

Hmm, Pinon-chan,
it kind of looks like you're scared of the water?

The truth is, I nearly drowned once
when I was little...
I see, so that's why you're scared of water...

You can get over a fear like that in no time,
Pinon-chan.
So let's give it a shot, Pinon-chan!

Somehow, when you say that,
I really feel like I can do it...
All right! Let's resume training!
That's the spirit, Pinon-chan!

By the end, you could put your face
in the water just fine.
At this rate, you'll be swimming in no time.
(Probably...)
Then next time, I'll swim for sure...!

(I'll have to keep practicing with Pinon-chan
until she can swim.)
That's the spirit, Pinon-chan!

By the end, you could put your face
in the water just fine.
At this rate, you'll be swimming in no time.

(I'll have to keep practicing with Pinon-chan
until she can swim.)

(Pinon-chan invited me shopping today.
It's our first time shopping together,
so I'm looking forward to it.)
(Hm? Is that Pinon-chan?)

Ah, I finally found you.
So the Shibuya Area gets this crowded
on days off...

With this many people around, we could get
separated the second we let our guard down.
Don't get lost, okay, Pinon-chan?

Hmm?! You just treated me like a child,
didn't you?

Sorry, sorry.
So, what are we going to buy today?

Yuu told me about a shop
that sells cute ribbons,
and I really want to go there.

Well, since we already know where we're headed,
let's go straight to that shop.
Nn... mm...... Ngh!

(Pinon-chan's getting swallowed up
by the crowd...)
This is no problem at all...!
(It sure doesn't look that way...)
How much farther is the shop?
We should be there any minute now...

Then let's hurry a little.
With this many people around,
we could easily get separated...
...Huh? Pinon-chan?!

Honestly, don't go wandering off
and getting lost on your own.
This is exactly why...
(So it's MY fault...)

So I have no choice... No choice at all, got it?!
I suppose I could hold your hand
so we don't get separated...

(Umm, I can take that to mean
she wants me to hold her hand, right?)

Yeah, good idea.
Then maybe I'll have you hold my hand
so we don't get separated.
Honestly... What am I going to do with you?
Then, Princess, may I have your hand?
Eek! P-Princess?!
Haha, come on, let's go.
O-okay...!

I'm glad you got a cute ribbon,
Pinon-chan.
Thank you. You really helped me out today.

For something like this,
I'll tag along anytime.

I'm counting on you next time we come here too.
And, um... hold my hand again...
Sure, I'd love to.
W-well then, thanks for today.

(Looks like Pinon-chan got what she wanted,
so I'm glad today turned into a fun shopping trip.)

(If we ever go shopping again,
I'll have to hold the princess's hand tight
so I don't lose her.)

(Pinon-chan invited me shopping today.
It's our first time shopping together,
so I'm looking forward to it.)

With this many people around, we could get
separated the second we let our guard down.
Don't get lost, okay, Pinon-chan?

uncertain: c12096: the Japanese names Pinon-chan twice ('Pinon-chan nara' = someone like you, and the closing address); both kept.
c12113: Pinon's 'Yuu' taken as Yuu Akimizu (glossary alias; Pinon uses the given name).
c12129/c12130/c12140: himesama rendered 'Princess' (the player's playful address to Pinon), matching c12154 in slice 166.
c12124-c12127, c12114, c12120, c12121, c12133, c12135, c12139, c12140: worded to match the already finished female counterparts in slice 166 (c12143-c12154).
